newsitem.title: MEXICO: U.S. President Bill Clinton's Mexico visit delayed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. President Bill Clinton's Mexico visit delayed.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton's visit to Mexico will be postponed to May 6-7 from the scheduled April 11-12, Mexico's Foreign Affairs Ministry said on Tuesday.
The ministry said in a statement that the date was changed "to allow President Clinton greater recovery after his knee operation."
Clinton's right knee was surgically repaired on March 14 after he tore a tendon by stumbling on some steps at the Florida estate of Australian golfer Greg Norman.
He left the hospital on March 16 and has been wheelchair-bound since then.
